page.heading: A restore you have already tested
body: Backups only matter on the day you need them. So we test them. Every quarter we restore real files and a whole server to prove the copies work, and we send you the result.
Servers, laptops and Microsoft 365 or Google accounts are backed up daily. One copy stays close for fast restores. Another sits offsite, locked so that ransomware cannot change or delete it.
We also write a short disaster plan with you: who to call, which systems come back first, and how long each step takes. It fits on two pages and lives somewhere you can reach without your network.
If something does go wrong, we restore the files or the whole machine and tell you what happened.
page.plans: Microsoft 365 or Google backup in every plan. Server and offsite backup in Business and Complete.

faq.q: How far back can we restore?
faq.a: Daily copies are kept for 30 days and monthly copies for a year. We can keep them longer if your industry requires it.

faq.q: How long does a full restore take?
faq.a: A single file takes minutes. A whole server usually takes a few hours. Your disaster plan lists the times for your systems.
The offsite copy is locked for a set period, so nothing can change or delete it, including an attacker with a stolen password.
